description: Unique ID for this row (one row per scanned source); use model_id plus source suffix.
Lowercase slug identifying the model; repeated across rows for the same model. Used later to consolidate.
Common name or acronym of the model.
Organization(s) responsible for development; separate multiple values with ';'.
Provinces/territories where the source says the model applies; separate multiple values with ';'.
Broad model class as stated in the source.
Species or species groups covered; separate multiple values with ';'.
Key model inputs; separate multiple values with ';'.
Key model outputs; separate multiple values with ';'.
Management actions the source says the model can represent (e.g. thinning; fertilization; pruning); separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not stated.
Other features the source says are represented (e.g. mortality; regeneration; climate; disturbance); separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not stated.
Lifecycle status if the source states it.
File name of the scanned source document.
Citation (authors; year; title) of the scanned source.
Publication year of the scanned source.
Uncertainties or ambiguities; do not guess values the source does not state.
